What is the best way to move Watchlist pages to Saved pages?

This is years, decades even, of bookmarks collected in Watchlist items. I know I haven't exhausted every crevice of where this info might be shared. And, I feel like there should be a simple way to move from one list to another. But, I'm not looking for something beyond what a normal user would be capable of. Ideally, this would not require a hack or whole cloth coding, and be something more vetted and reversible (if something went wrong).
